# oneyaml

**One core, one interpretation: serde and lossless, comment-preserving
editing for YAML 1.2, correct by default and free of panics.**

feature-complete competitor (higher is better). The numbers, as tables

[crate README](crates/oneyaml/README.md); every workload and how to
reproduce them are in [docs/performance.md](docs/performance.md).

## Install

```sh
cargo add oneyaml serde -F serde/derive
```

## Where to go

- **Using oneyaml:** the [crate README](crates/oneyaml/README.md) (also the
  [docs.rs front page](https://docs.rs/oneyaml)): quick start, untrusted
  input, merge keys, and a guide to the API reference for editing,
  comments, streams, diagnostics and settings.
- **Moving from `serde_yaml`, `serde_yaml_ng` or `serde_norway`:**
  [the migration guide](docs/migrating-from-serde-yaml.md).
- **Choosing a YAML crate:** [how oneyaml compares](docs/comparison.md),
  including where the others win.
- **Evidence:** [yaml-test-suite conformance](docs/conformance.md),
  [performance](docs/performance.md),
  [fuzzing](crates/fuzz/README.md),
  [comment attachment rules](docs/comment-attachment.md).
- **What changed:** [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).
- **Contributing and security:** [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md),
  [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md), [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).

## Crates

| Crate | What it is |
|---|---|
| [`oneyaml`](crates/oneyaml/README.md) | The library: serde, `Value`, the lossless `Document`. Start here. |
| [`oneyaml-core`](crates/oneyaml-core/README.md) | Stable vocabulary: spans, diagnostic codes, paths, settings, limits. Re-exported by `oneyaml`. |
| [`oneyaml-syntax`](crates/oneyaml-syntax/README.md) | The lossless parser, event stream and syntax tree, for tooling. Its own semver track. |
